judged_text: In packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts:8,10, minimumTokenResponseSchema uses computed keys [z.string().toString()] and [z.string().optional().toString()], which both evaluate to the string "[object Object]" so the second silently overwrites the first; the resulting schema validates almost nothing, and since z.object strips unknown keys by default, every parsed token response in credential-sharing mode is reduced to { access_token }, discarding refresh_token, expiry_date/expires_in, instance_url, etc. before persistence
